safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a statement of “no significant family history” is primarily a documentation completeness issue and is unlikely to change acute management of an insect sting reaction. At most, it may cause minor downstream chart ambiguity or additional questioning.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting a localized rash/redness when the gold finding states no rash could mislead future clinicians toward an allergic/inflammatory skin reaction and away from alternative explanations, potentially affecting follow-up decisions or prompting unnecessary symptomatic treatment. This discrepancy is unlikely to cause major harm but can create avoidable diagnostic/management noise.
